item.description: The IOPort class lacks proper integer conversion support, causing TypeError when trying to interpret IOPort objects as integers or convert them to IO values in various contexts.
item.contract: Modify the IOPort class to properly support integer conversion via __int__ method and ensure it can be correctly interpreted as an IO value in all contexts where IO operations are performed. The __int__ method should return the width of the IOPort.

item.description: StructLayout and ArrayLayout classes do not properly support integer conversion, causing TypeError when these layout objects are interpreted as integers in contexts expecting numeric values.
item.contract: Modify StructLayout and ArrayLayout classes to implement __int__ method that returns the size of the layout, enabling proper integer conversion for layout objects.

item.description: Missing or incorrect imports for IO-related classes (Input, Output, Bidir) in the io module, causing AttributeError when these symbols are referenced in tests.
item.contract: Ensure that Input, Output, and Bidir are properly imported and exported from amaranth.lib.io module to make them available for test cases that reference these symbols.

item.description: Const class does not allow subclassing, preventing proper inheritance for data structures that require it.
item.contract: Modify the Const class to allow proper subclassing while maintaining backward compatibility. Remove or relax restrictions that prevent subclassing.

item.description: Inconsistent error message formatting in IO buffer validation, causing assertion failures due to mismatched error messages.
item.contract: Standardize error message formatting in IO buffer validation to ensure consistent error messages that match test expectations.
